about: Fixed vocabulary for isolate source metadata, shared by every species. Specific terms carry ontology ids (ENVO environments and materials, UBERON body sites, PO plant parts, FoodOn foods, NCBITaxon hosts); every id and its ontology_label were checked against EBI OLS4 on verified_on (python steps/metadata_curation.py --verify-vocabulary re-checks them). A term's niche and source category are fixed groupings of terms, so labels mean the same thing in every species. Body-site terms take their source category from the host (human, animal, plant or not stated). Bump version whenever a term, host, label or grouping changes, i.e. anything the models are shown: cached model answers are keyed on it. Bump rules_revision instead when only synonyms, the missing / uninformative value lists or not_placed_by_descent change: those decide which records the rules settle and which fields the models see, and cached answers stay valid because they are keyed on the exact fields each model was shown.
